name: Ares
title: God of War
summary: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: The war god’s lust for violence and his berserk rages turn fields into carnage, fortresses into charnel houses. As a lover and instigator of conflict, Ares adores the post-Shattering world. Thus far he has contented himself with the slaughter of monsters and with the bloodshed of small skirmishes, but he hopes to ignite ongoing wars between Olympus and other Realms.
